title: The execution model: what runs, and in what order
hook: ComfyUI starts from the output nodes and works backwards. Build its scheduler in 60 lines and watch a lazy input change the order.

verified.claim: A graph with one good output and one broken one still ran the good one.
A real lazy node's order was check, branch, check, execute, and the other branch did not run.
nm_dead_branch ran here with its unused node idle.
ux_friendly_pick_node prefers output and async nodes, then nodes feeding an output, and its comment says the output rule has no effect on overall length, while the async rule reduces overall time.
ExecutionBlocker with None stopped downstream silently, and the run still counted as a success.

unchecked: The lab's scheduler is a small copy. It leaves out async nodes and caching, and its pick rule is a simplified one.
